themeCardDescription: Choose the appearance of the application.
securityCardDescription: Configure two-factor authentication and other security options.
backupCodesDescription: Single-use codes to recover your account
totpEnabledDescription: Enabled — a code will be requested when unlocking
totpDisabledDescription: Requires a code from your phone in addition to the master password
totpDisableConfirmDescription: You'll be able to unlock Sailock with just your master password again.
totpSetupDescription: Scan this code with Google Authenticator, Authy, or your preferred authenticator app.
autoLockCardDescription: Automatically lock the session after a period of inactivity.
autoLockIntervalDescription: Time to wait before locking the session
lockOnMinimizeDescription: Locks the session when the window is minimized
startWithWindowsDescription: Sailock will launch automatically when you start your PC
minimizeToTrayDescription: Saves the preference; real integration is missing
autoUpdateDescription: Sailock will check for updates on startup
importExportCardDescription: Export an encrypted copy of your vault, or add data from a previously exported file.
exportDataDescription: Creates an encrypted file with a password you choose
importDataDescription: Add or replace entries from a .slock file
exportDialogDescription: Choose a password just for this file — it doesn't have to be your master password. Without it, no one can open the exported file.
exportMinLengthError: The password must be at least 8 characters long
importStepFormDescription: Choose the file and the password it was exported with.
importStepConfirmDescription: Review what will happen before continuing.
importStepTotpDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
importPasswordPlaceholder: The password chosen when it was exported
importPasswordHint: Not your master password — it's the specific password created when that file was exported.
importModeLabel: What to do with the entries
enterPasswordError: Enter the password for that file
replaceWarning: This will permanently delete all entries currently in this vault, and replace them with the ones from the imported file.
addWillBeAddedNotice: The entries from the file will be added to your current vault.
deleteCardDescription: Permanently deletes all your data. This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmIntro: This action will permanently delete all your data:
deleteConfirmTypeLabel: To confirm, type {{phrase}} in the field below.
accessibilityCardDescription: Adjust the app to make it more comfortable to use.
reduceMotionDescription: Minimizes interface transitions and motion effects.
backupCodesRequiresTotp: Enable it after setting up two-step verification
backupCodesConfirmDescription: Enter your master password to generate a new batch. This invalidates any previous codes.
backupCodesShownOnceWarning: Save these codes somewhere safe — they won't be shown again. Each one works only once.
